title: The exams: every new generation's students judged once on their sealed decisions
request: Phase 7 (the owner): a student behind every choice, promoted only where proven; 29.5: the exams.
plan: The exam runner takes any generation (v1, v2, the images): its homework and its cards.
Each new student judged once by decision_gate_v1, fixed before the runs.
The verdicts stored; nothing serves without one.

decisions.decision: The same gate version for every generation.
decisions.why: One set of thresholds, fixed before any of these runs: a gate moved after seeing a student is no gate.

decisions.decision: Each sealed set read once, here.
decisions.why: A sealed set seen twice is dev material.

change: decision_gate_run --set v1|v2|images; seven verdicts DMG-007 to DMG-013.

measurements.name: the seven new students' sealed exams (DMG-007 to DMG-013)
measurements.gate: decision_gate_v1 (22.3), fixed before the runs: accuracy at least 0.9 at the lower bound, a margin over the rule, no class missed, at most 2% of the rule's right answers turned wrong
measurements.result: all seven fail. task.framing 0.918 (lower bound 0.886 < 0.9; 6.6% of the rule's right answers turned wrong); data.cases_table, data.cleaning_step and split.strategy beat their rules by 0.19 to 0.26 at the lower bound but turn 10 to 21% of the rule's right answers wrong (cleaning misses trim, split misses group and stratified); image.flip_safe and image.label_suspect no margin over near-perfect rules; image.near_copy 0.911 (lower bound under 0.9)
measurements.against_gate: Failed: none serves; all stay in shadow.
limits: Invented tables and images: these exams say how the students read these planted kinds.
The bar on the rule's right answers kept is the one most failed: a student that beats its rule overall but breaks what the rule gets right is not promoted, by design.

outcome: Every new student has a sealed verdict; none passed, so none serves; the next homework targets what they break.
lessons: A gate that also protects the rule's right answers keeps a better-on-average student out: the next homework must teach the cases it breaks.
risks: Without passed students the shadow answers stay evidence only.
